all_day_hint: Skip time pickers (good for birthdays, holidays)
delete_event_body: This event repeats {{recurrence}}. Choose what to delete — just this {{day}}, this and all future, or every occurrence in the series.
delete_single_body: This will permanently remove "{{title}}" from your calendar.
empty_body: Tap + to add your first event.
schedule_empty_body: No upcoming events. Enjoy the calm!
tutorial_step1_body: Each household member gets a coloured dot. The day cells show whose events are on which day — so a glance tells you Tuesday is Leo's day, not just a busy day.
tutorial_step2_body: Tap any member's name at the top to see only their events. Or tap 'Just me' to focus on your own schedule.
tutorial_step3_title: Tap a day to see events
tutorial_step3_body: Tap any date in the grid to scroll to that day's agenda below. Tap an event to see full details, edit, or reschedule.
